scope: Strict nested response contract for the private location-scoped waste operations summary.

constraints.extra_fields: forbidden at every response object level
constraints.incident_enums: match pollution incident severity and status checks
constraints.counts: strict nonnegative integers; grouped records require at least one
constraints.group_bounds: derived only from checked domain enums or the existing recent-quality limit
constraints.request_scope: top-level and composting-efficiency locations must match the path; period must match the requested days value
constraints.validation: Explicitly validate the service projection before returning JSONResponse

error_contract.database_failure: existing sanitized 503 and Retry-After: 30 path unchanged
error_contract.invalid_projection: sanitized 500 with Cache-Control: no-store and Vary: Cookie

limitations: This closes one aggregate response-contract slice only; live OIDC behavior, populated-data parity, and broader tenant isolation remain separate gates.
